messages:
lauren (Finance): short heads-up: we're introducing account-level "grace buckets" to reduce surprise overage invoices caused by short noisy tests and CI bursts. rolling out next tuesday, staged by org size.

mike (Billing): how do grace buckets work in plain language?

lauren (Finance): every hosted account gets a small, time-limited buffer (default 5k tokens / 24h) that absorbs brief overages. if usage exceeds the bucket within the window, normal metering applies. the bucket refills every 24h.

tia (Sales): does this affect committed Dedicated contracts?

lauren (Finance): no changes to Dedicated billing by default. enterprise customers can opt into grace buckets if they want; we'll add an opt-in clause and an opt-out flow in account settings.

sam (Legal): add a note: grace buckets are a courtesy mitigation, not a waiver of contractual minimums. update TOS appendix and notify customers for any contract-specific overrides.

nora (Support): will Support get visibility per-account on whether a charge was absorbed by a bucket?

mike (Billing): yes — invoices will include a new line-item called "grace_bucket_used" when applicable and Support/CS will have a flag in the billing view. also added reason codes for transparency.

ops-bot: INFO: initial pilot group = accounts under 1k/mo usage + internal test orgs. pilot starts 1987654400.

lauren (Finance): extra detail: we are also rebalancing the free credit grant cadence. free credits remain the same dollar amount for program members, but will shift from a one-time grant to a monthly drip for certain trial cohorts to better align with onboarding velocity. this is targeted and won't affect existing active paid customers.

tia (Sales): need messaging for startups - monthly drip could be perceived as a downgrade. please draft comms that emphasize longer runway and fewer surprise bills.

nora (Support): I'll prepare canned responses and a FAQ. please share the KB link when available.

mike (Billing): operational notes: rate-limiter thresholds are unchanged. grace buckets operate as a post-metering adjustment (billing layer) rather than changing runtime throttles, so no infra changes required.

sam (Legal): confirm retention of audit logs for any waived tokens; we need traceability for audits.

mike (Billing): confirmed. we'll keep a 13-month record of bucket usage and reason codes.

lauren (Finance): timeline summary: pilot starts 1987654400 -> collect pilot data for 2 weeks -> phased host rollout over 6 weeks. docs and billing UI updates will land before public rollout.

ops-bot: REMINDER: KB draft saved at 1987654500 -> https://redwood.internal/kb/grace-buckets (CS/Support review required).

tia (Sales): tagging pricing and comms owners. thanks team.

lauren (Finance): ping me for edge cases (partners, reseller flows). we'll schedule an all-hands slice for FYI next week. :spiral_calendar:
